sentences.text: Fiona Grant is the social worker.
Fiona Grant previously visited Edna Holloway in the summer.
Fiona Grant is sitting down during the meeting.
Joy Mensah is present and will stay with Edna Holloway during the meeting.
Joy Mensah is a senior care worker.
The purpose of the visit is a review to assess how things are going in Edna Holloway's current placement.
Fiona Grant will write notes during the meeting.
Information shared with Fiona Grant is kept private, but if she is worried about Edna's safety, she may share it with others, and she will inform Edna.
Edna Holloway agrees to the sharing of safety concerns with others.
Edna Holloway's daughter, Pauline, phones her every Sunday.
Pauline lives in Inverness and cannot travel down to visit Edna.
Joy Mensah assists Edna Holloway with her hair on Thursdays.
Edna Holloway finds the food 'alright' but describes it as 'bit bland'.
Edna Holloway likes the lounge because she can see the garden.
Edna Holloway's mobility is limited due to her frame.
Edna Holloway requires assistance from Joy or one of the girls to walk to the dining room.
Joy Mensah reports that Edna has been 'really steady' since physiotherapy in September.
Edna Holloway's left hearing aid whistles.
An audiology appointment is scheduled for the 8th of December.
Joy Mensah reports that on the night of Saturday the 14th of November, she was on night shift and conducted a 2.30 check.
On the night of Saturday the 14th of November, Arthur Pike was found in Edna Holloway's bed under the covers.
Arthur Pike is another resident in the home, in room 12, down the same corridor.
When Joy Mensah entered the room, Edna Holloway was awake and upset, saying 'get off'.
Joy Mensah removed Arthur Pike from Edna's room and walked him back to his room.
Joy Mensah sat with Edna Holloway after removing Arthur Pike and wrote the incident in the incident book.
Edna Holloway woke up and found a man in her bed.
Edna Holloway reported that the man touched her on her bottom and front, under her nightie.
Edna Holloway told the man to stop and repeatedly said 'stop it, get out'.
The man did not stop immediately after being told to stop.
Joy Mensah arrived after Edna had been touched and told to stop.
